findings.evidenceJa: 気配を感じ取った訳じゃない

findings.highlight: Sakura dreamily steps into my room.
findings.evidenceJa: 戸惑いがちに襖を開けて
findings.governingReading: 戸惑いがち marks uncertainty as she opens the door and enters, preceding apologetic embarrassment.

findings.highlight: But it if hurt that much
findings.evidenceJa: 布を緩めただけであんなに痛む
findings.governingReading: Even slight cloth loosening hurt, excluding a cut to the graft.
findings.explanation: If it hurt is printed it if hurt.

findings.highlight: Blood leaks out, brighter than I expected.
findings.evidenceJa: 思ったより景気よく血が出てくる
findings.governingReading: 景気よく qualifies the amount/strength of blood emerging.
findings.explanation: A more vigorous blood flow becomes brighter blood.

findings.highlight: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.
findings.evidenceJa: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
findings.governingReading: The two sides are separately assigned pain/fear and pleasure/loss; 喪失 supplies depletion alongside sensation.
findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.
